Module  java.base
Software package  java.lang

Class StringBuilder

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.StringBuilder
  • All implemented interfaces
    Serializable ， Appendable ， CharSequence ， Comparable<StringBuilder> 
    public final class StringBuilder
extends Object
implements Serializable, Comparable<StringBuilder>, CharSequence
    A mutable sequence of characters. This class provides an API compatible withStringBufferCompatible API, but synchronization is not guaranteed. This class is designed to be used asStringBufferA replacement for places where a string buffer is used by a single thread (the usual case). Where possible, it is recommended to use this class in preference toStringBufferbecause it will be faster in most implementations.

    StringBuilderThe main operation on it isappendandinsertmethods, which are overloaded to accept any type of data. Each effectively converts the given data to a string, then appends or inserts the characters of that string into the string builder. appendmethod always appends these characters at the end of the builder; insertThe method adds characters at the specified point.

    For example, ifzrefers to its current contents as “startthe string builder object, then the method callz.append("le")will cause the string builder to contain “startle”, andz.insert(4, "le")Will change the string builder to containstarlet ”。

    In general, if one is referring to an instanceStringBuilder, thensb.append(x)has the same effectsb.insert(sb.length(), x) 。

    Each string builder has a capacity. As long as the length of the character sequence contained in the string builder does not exceed the capacity, it is not necessary to allocate a new internal buffer. If the internal buffer overflows, it automatically becomes larger.

    StringBuilderInstances are not suitable for multi-threaded use. If such synchronization is required, it is recommended to useStringBuffer 。

    Unless otherwise specified, it willnullparameter passed tonullthe constructor or method in ... will cause ... to be thrown.NullPointerException 。
